winnerRule.unit: FIRST_ENTER_PER_SYMBOL_SESSION; compare methods on identical admitted Hybrid cross-sections
winnerRule.evaluability: All15 Validation/all10 OOS sessions complete; both methods have at least1 firstENTER with complete+3 and complete+1 adverse label in each session, else INCONCLUSIVE_NO_PROMOTION; no drop-or-replace sessions
winnerRule.expectancy: Equal-session-weight mean AND median of NEW-minus-P21 session mean netReturn3 must both be >0
winnerRule.stability: NEW-minus-P21 netReturn3 positive in a strict majority of planned sessions
winnerRule.adverse: Equal-session-weight mean NEW-minus-P21 next1bar adverse rate must be <0
winnerRule.coverage: Aggregate firstENTER coverage must not be lower than P21 on identical selected symbol-session denominator; no fixed percent target
winnerRule.missingness: NEW firstENTER +3 and +1 label completeness must each be no worse than P21; report all censored rows, never optimize missingness
winnerRule.sideAudit: Both sides reported; missing side comparability yields INCONCLUSIVE_NO_PROMOTION, no side-specific threshold
winnerRule.failure: Any failed criterion -> NO_GO; any missing criterion -> INCONCLUSIVE_NO_PROMOTION; retain P21, no model expansion
winnerRule.thresholdProcedure: NOT_AUTHORIZED_UNTIL_TRAINING_CONTRACT; exactly one scalar and no post-OOS tuning
